Night of 31 Oct · 6 pm to noon
Selected sources: Example data, not field readings

About 95.7–144.3 L left the tank on the night of 31 Oct (6 pm to noon) that the generator's modelled use and the recorded deliveries don't explain.

The tank sensor sent no readings from 00:45 to 02:30.
Worth about 119.57–180.43 USD at your declared 1.25 USD per litre (a modelled range that includes the stated margin)
The range allows for the tank sensor's declared accuracy of 10 L at each reading, 10 % either way on the generator's modelled use, and 1 % on each recorded delivery.
This does not say why the fuel left the tank.
